title: Nahas
summary: Raleigh names Nahas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Nahas, the cruell King of the Ammonites who besieged Iabes Gilead. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. VI, sig. 249b
